title: NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: FANTASY IN THE MIRAGE
lines: 01 NEW STORY COLLECTION EVENT: FANTASY IN THE MIRAGE
EVENT STAGES DURATION: December 11, 2025, 08:00 – December 18, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
STAGE DROPS: 'Sweetie', Materials, etc.

DETAILS: Fantasy in the Mirage event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain 'Sweetie' by clearing event stages. 'Sweetie' can be used to redeem event rewards and Information Fragments in [A School for Item Spirits]. Information Fragments can be used to unlock the stories in Story Collection.
[A School for Item Spirits]
DURATION: December 11, 2025, 08:00 – December 21, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
REWARDS: 0011 Yun Series - Soaring Will for Bison, Information Fragments, Module Materials, Elite Materials, Battle Records, LMD, Recruitment Permits, etc.
Note:
After the event ends, this event will be included in the [Public Affairs].
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING OPEN – THE ROLLING THUNDER
DURATION: December 11, 2025, 08:00 – December 25, 2025, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [The Rolling Thunder], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Leizi the Thunderbringer
★★★★★: Record Keeper / Warmy
Note:

This is a [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.
03 NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Leizi the Thunderbringer
★★★★★: Record Keeper
Note:
- Leizi the Thunderbringer and Record Keeper will become available in other [Standard Headhuntings] after December 25, 2025, 04:00 (UTC-7).
- Leizi the Thunderbringer and Record Keeper will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.
04 SANITY REFUND & PRACTICE OPTIMIZATION
UPDATE TIME: December 11, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: After the update on December 11, 2025, 08:00 (UTC-7), Sanity Refund and the Practice mode will be optimized. Regardless of whether it is the first time a stage is attempted, if a battle fails or an operation is abandoned, all Sanity consumed will be fully refunded. In addition, Practice Drill will no longer consume Drill Plan and will become an unlimited-use feature.
